chapters.label: The save, live
chapters.text: Moscow, World Cup 2018: penalties against Colombia! Jordan Henderson's kick is saved, but England keep believing. Carlos Bacca steps up. Jordan Pickford waits. Bacca shoots, Pickford dives right... Saved! Eric Dier scores. England win!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it slowly. Pickford dives early. The ball flies above him, so he whips up his back hand!

chapters.label: From behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind: that left hand! Pickford jumps and punches the air.

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Keepers, commit to your dive and reach with a strong hand. If your team misses, keep believing! Bacca was brave to step up.
